messages.subject: [IT] DMS maintenance window - Saturday 14 Feb, 07:00-11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable this Saturday 14 February between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and check in any open documents beforehand. Email and the phones are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
